scenarios.name: A daily series is forward-filled onto the minute grid

steps.text: each minute carries the most recent prior daily <column> value

scenarios.name: A gap in the daily series carries forward, never interpolates

steps.text: a daily <source> series with a missing day
minutes in the missing day carry the last known prior <column> value
no value is interpolated between the surrounding days

scenarios.name: Minutes before any data exists have no feature value

steps.text: a daily <source> series whose first observation is on day 2
minutes before day 2 have no <column> value
that absence is not fabricated as zero

scenarios.name: GDELT event_intensity is the unweighted mean of goldstein_scale per day

steps.text: GDELT events on 2020-01-05 with goldstein_scale -4.0, 2.0, and 6.0
avg_tone is not folded into event_intensity

background.text: canonical event Parquet exists for gdelt and gpr
